topic: Can satellite orbital configurations optimize ML-based QoS by reducing propagation delays for latency-sensitive traffic classes?
response: Satellite orbital configurations can reduce propagation delays, but the Context lacks specific data on ML-based QoS optimization. Generally, lower Earth orbits (LEO) have less latency than geostationary orbits (GEO).
reference_context: Context discusses QoS in converged satellite and terrestrial networks, highlighting challenges with high fixed latencies in satellite links.
